_source: Remaster rule data, not in the ST monster table. Indices are monsters.json 'index'. See DIFFERENCES-II.md D2-022 / D2-023.

_fields.undead: D2-022 (user s80: manual, as I's D-024, and PLUTO'S UNDEAD SNAKE (72) is undead): DISPELL UNDEAD affects these (manual: skeletons, zombies, ghosts and others returned from the grave). I's nine plus the snake. The ST's XP % 7 == 0 test (combat case 0x842c) is the rules option p2.dispell-undead = st: it also hits BANTIR (1), DEMON (48), HIGH DEMON (60) and misses the snake.
_fields.never_flees: D2-023 (user s80: manual, as I: FEAR makes the monsters run; the ST's level drop is p2.fear = st). User s81: Pluto (79), PLUTO'S ICE DRAGON (78) and Pluto's eight minions (17, 43, 72-77; endgame.md 3.1) stand fast, as I's Black Lord; p2.fear-bosses = flee lets them run.
